text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 细银项链。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: ACCESSORY PRODUCT PHOTO. One fine silver chain necklace only, no pendant. Pure white background, product centered and large. Use reference only to identify this accessory. No clothes, shirt, trousers, shoes, human, mannequin, body, skin, text, watermark or other objects. Entire accessory visible, soft studio light.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。文字图案以视觉参考为主，未逐图重生成验证。
